retired.reason: Failed every month since July: the unit runs scripts/mint-service-token.sh as root, which calls `forge node exec` back into hetzner-bob, and root on bob has no forge login ("not logged in"). Even when it worked it only wrote a new never-expiring token to /opt/omnibank/merchant-service-token.txt, which no service reads; it did not push the token to Workers or revoke the old one, so it was credential sprawl, not rotation. OmniBank service tokens are minted with expires=NULL (shadybank src/apiserver.py post_service_tokens), so nothing expires while it is off. Rotation is the ops-host script scripts/rotate-service-token.sh in gmackie/shadybank.
retired.restore: Restore the two unit files from the backup tarball and `systemctl enable --now omnibank-token-rotate.timer` only after the mint script runs node-locally (docker exec) and revokes the previous token.
